scientific_integrity: Exact analytical derivation accompanies an independently implemented finite edge-incidence checker. Finite sampling alone does not prove universal statements. Earlier central-section and fixed-plane section-volume work is acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: The closed probability formulas are restricted to orthogonal three-dimensional rectangular boxes, under rigid-motion-invariant affine-plane measure conditioned on meeting the box. For arbitrary nondegenerate parallelotopes only p5=p3-2p6 is claimed. Degenerate planes are measure zero. Priority may be affected by inaccessible historical cube-section literature; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Complete Crofton polygon-type law for planar sections of rectangular boxes
